name: Hyperthyroidism
overview: Hyperthyroidism is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, hyperthyroidism is a endocrine disease in which the thyroid gland produces excessive amounts of thyroid hormones.
From a clinical perspective, thyrotoxicosis is a condition that occurs due to elevated levels of thyroid hormones of any cause and therefore includes hyperthyroidism.
From a clinical perspective, some, however, use the terms interchangeably.
In routine practice, signs and symptoms vary between people and may include irritability, muscle weakness, sleeping problems, a fast heartbeat, heat intolerance, diarrhea...
From a clinical perspective, symptoms are typically less severe in the elderly and during pregnancy.
